appraisal_events.evidence: il avait perdu toute relation avec celui qu'il appelait le « jeune Verdurin » et qu'il considérait ... comme tombé – tout en gardant de nombreux millions – dans la bohème et la racaille
appraisal_events.explanation: The grandfather regards Verdurin himself, independent of Swann, as having socially fallen into a disreputable milieu despite his wealth.

appraisal_events.evidence: « ça doit cacher une histoire de femme, je ne me mêle pas de ces affaires-là. » ... c'est Odette qui avait amené elle-même Swann chez les Verdurin.
appraisal_events.explanation: The grandfather's suspicious dismissal of an unnamed 'affaire de femme' is retrospectively confirmed to be Odette, implicitly linking her to the disreputable scheme he refuses to touch.

status_effects.explanation: In the grandfather's view, Verdurin has fallen into a low, disreputable milieu, marking a decline in perceived social standing.
The reveal that Odette herself engineered Swann's introduction to the Verdurins retrospectively confirms the grandfather's suspicion of a disreputable 'affaire de femme' behind the request.

ambiguities: The grandfather's remark 'ça doit cacher une histoire de femme, je ne me mêle pas de ces affaires-là' does not name Odette directly; the link to her is established only by the following sentence, so whether this constitutes a genuine discredit of Odette or is simply plot exposition confirming a guess is uncertain.
